summary.approvalStatus: Source approvals were not linked to exact image hashes. No approval inferred from filename or upload order.

source: Recovered Workout Program Library inventory and Exercise_Asset_Equipment_Mapping.md

standards.appearance: Medium-tone athletic male; short dark hair, trimmed beard; shirtless, black shorts, plain white shoes
standards.environment: Charcoal wall, dark rubber floor, necessary equipment only
standards.workflow: One exercise at a time. START only, then user approval, then matching FINISH. No approval inferred from names.
standards.conversion: Lossless full-size WebP, pixel-verified against the decoded original. No retouching, cropping or image generation.
standards.primaryEligibility: One person, one pose, no embedded labels or diagram panels. Mapped to visible equipment and movement.
